sections.Profile:
The "Star Trek" pinball machine, released by Data East in October 1991, is based on the original Star Trek television series. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and Ed Cebula, the game features two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. The machine integrates thematic elements from the show, including iconic characters and sound effects.
